page.intro: Every dashboard setting of the main and the support server in one file. Use it before big changes, or to move to a new host. Secrets are never in it.
page.loadHelp: Nothing changes yet: you first see every setting the file would change, then choose to apply it.
page.loadNeedsAdmin: Loading a backup needs Administrator and editing turned on.

preview.title: Check the backup
preview.once: This works once and expires in 10 minutes. Every change goes to the audit log.
preview.same: The file matches the current settings. Nothing would change.

route.expired: That check expired or was already used. Load the file again.

applied.one: Backup applied: {count} setting changed. They are in the audit log.
applied.other: Backup applied: {count} settings changed. They are in the audit log.

route.applyFailed: The backup was not applied: the database did not answer, so nothing was changed. Try Apply again.
